replies.author: _Phyre
replies.body:
1. Download and install forge (1.7.10)
  - Tell me if you need links for 1.7.2 / 1.8
2. Download Player API and Toggle Sprint.
  - Make sure you have Java 
3. Put the two in your mods folder.
  + IF you do not have mods folder, just make one
